'''2020 TMW Pods Stephen Squirlock DS No Money, No Parts, No Deal!''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Stephen Squirlock]] at [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Pods).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Stephen Squirlock]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]]
* '''Stage:''' Pods
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?|Cor-D-nomoneynopartsnodeal.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open NMNPND Squirlock DS 2020 Texas.txt |Download]]
